title: Isaiah's prophecy to King Ahaz
description: When Rezin of Aram and Pekah of Israel march against Jerusalem, King Ahaz and the people tremble with fear. The Lord sends Isaiah with his son Shear-Jashub to reassure the king: the two hostile kings—"smoldering firebrands"—will not succeed, but if Ahaz does not believe, he will not stand firm. Later, Isaiah announces that the Lord will bring the king of Assyria against Judah—a devastating judgment where the land becomes a thicket and grazing ground.
